installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# AirLock — Discord VC Manager · installation
# Install container is Debian bookworm, matching the parkervcp/yolks Node runtime.
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates

if [ -z "${GIT_REPO:-}" ]; then
  echo "[!] GIT_REPO is empty."
  exit 1
fi
BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -d /mnt/server/.git ]; then
  echo "[*] Updating existing checkout to origin/${BRANCH} ..."
  git remote set-url origin "${GIT_REPO}"
  git fetch origin "${BRANCH}"
  git reset --hard "origin/${BRANCH}"
else
  echo "[*] Cloning ${GIT_REPO} (branch ${BRANCH}) ..."
  git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_REPO}" /tmp/repo
  cp -R /tmp/repo/. /mnt/server/
  rm -rf /tmp/repo
fi

echo "[*] Installing dependencies ..."
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --omit=dev
else
  npm install --omit=dev
fi

# Fail loudly rather than letting the panel mark a broken server as "installed".
echo "[*] Verifying install ..."
test -d /mnt/server/node_modules || { echo "[!] node_modules missing"; exit 1; }
test -d /mnt/server/node_modules/@napi-rs/canvas || { echo "[!] @napi-rs/canvas missing"; exit 1; }
test -f /mnt/server/index.js || { echo "[!] index.js missing"; exit 1; }
test -f /mnt/server/font.ttf || echo "[warn] font.ttf missing — banner text may not render"

echo "[*] Install complete."

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: HTTPS URL of the bot's repository (must be public).

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Keep secret.

variables.name: Guild ID
variables.description: Optional. A server ID for INSTANT slash-command registration. Leave blank for a public bot (global sync, can take up to ~1 hour to appear).

variables.name: Auto Update On Boot
variables.description: 1 = git reset to the latest branch commit and reinstall dependencies on every start. Slows boot; leave at 0 and use Reinstall instead.
